correctness.rationale: The actual final claim concerns Hom(directed C3,P11) with standard product-cell orientation and all cells. Independent exhaustive set-system enumeration gives (165,495,330) cellular counts; d1*d2=0; independently verified connected 1-skeleton (rank d1=164). An independently written integer unimodular reduction performs 329 pivots of ±1 on d2 and leaves one column with 33 entries of magnitude 33 (gcd 33). Thus SNF(d2)=(1^329,33), full rank 330, H0=Z, H1=Z⊕Z/33, H2=0; no higher cells. Modular ranks (2,3,5,7,11,13) independently agree. No homotopy-type or pi1 statement is proved.
residual_risks: Only one target P11, and homology rather than fundamental group/full homotopy type.
